subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 Action revisions as one bundle after reviewing their upstream code changes and refreshed exact-head workflow results?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes third-party executable code inside privileged security, release, credential, and agent workflows; accepting that boundary requires human supply-chain judgment.

options.title: Approve after upstream audit
options.body: Review the upstream release and commit deltas, refresh exact-head checks, and merge the immutable pins together if no privileged behavior changed unexpectedly.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publication, and CodeQL updates so each high-impact family has isolated validation and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve after upstream audit
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release and commit deltas, refresh exact-head checks, and merge the immutable pins together if no privileged behavior changed unexpectedly.
